library.name: NessoLink
library.author: Ugur Sayar <ugursayar@gmail.com>
library.sentence: Versioned binary control-link protocol for the Nesso N1 robot controller.
library.paragraph: RemoteFrame v1/v2 codec (motors, up to two aux sticks, a 16-button bitfield, CRC-8 checked) plus WiFi UDP, TCP, BLE and LoRa (RadioLib) transports. The codec is header-only and dependency-free, so it runs on both the transmitter and the robot receiver on any board; each transport is compile-guarded, so codec-only users pull in no heavy dependencies.
